text_en: Listen, children, to a father’s instruction, and be attentive, that you may gain insight;
text_cn: 孩子，你们要听父亲的教训，专心学习明智，

text_en: for I give you good precepts: do not forsake my teaching.
text_cn: 因为我把好教训授给你们，你们不要抛弃我的规劝。

text_en: When I was a son with my father, tender, and my mother’s favorite,
text_cn: 我也曾在父亲面前作过孝子，在我母亲膝下是唯一的娇儿。

text_en: he taught me, and said to me, “Let your heart hold fast my words; keep my commandments, and live.
text_cn: 我父曾训诲我说：你应留心牢记我的话，遵守我的命令，好使你生存；

text_en: Get wisdom; get insight: do not forget, nor turn away from the words of my mouth.
text_cn: 你应紧握智慧，握住明智，不要忘记，也不要离弃我口中的教训：

text_en: Do not forsake her, and she will keep you; love her, and she will guard you.
text_cn: 你若不舍弃她，她必护佑你；你若喜爱她，她必看顾你。

text_en: The beginning of wisdom is this: Get wisdom, and whatever else you get, get insight.
text_cn: 首先应争取的是智慧，因此你应寻求智慧，应牺牲一切去争取明智。

text_en: Prize her highly, and she will exalt you; she will honor you if you embrace her.
text_cn: 你若显扬智慧，智慧也必显扬你；你若怀抱她，她也必光荣你：

text_en: She will place on your head a fair garland; she will bestow on you a beautiful crown. ”
text_cn: 将华冠加在你的头上，将荣冕赐给你。

text_en: Hear, my child, and accept my words, that the years of your life may be many.
text_cn: 我儿，你若听取我的训言，你必延年益寿。

text_en: I have taught you the way of wisdom; I have led you in the paths of uprightness.
text_cn: 我要教给你智慧的道路，引你走上正直的途径：

text_en: When you walk, your step will not be hampered; and if you run, you will not stumble.
text_cn: 这样，你若行走，你的脚决不会受阻碍；即便你奔驰，也决不致颠仆。

text_en: Keep hold of instruction; do not let go; guard her, for she is your life.
text_cn: 你要坚持教训，切勿把她抛弃；你应保存她，因为她是你的生命。

text_en: Do not enter the path of the wicked, and do not walk in the way of evildoers.
text_cn: 恶人的道路，你不要进去；坏人的途径，你不要踏入；

text_en: Avoid it; do not go on it; turn away from it and pass on.
text_cn: 反应躲避，不经其上；远远离去，绕道他往。

text_en: For they cannot sleep unless they have done wrong; they are robbed of sleep unless they have made someone stumble.
text_cn: 因为他们不作恶，不能入睡；不使人跌倒，就要失眠。

text_en: For they eat the bread of wickedness and drink the wine of violence.
text_cn: 他们吃的是邪恶的饼，饮的是暴虐的酒。

text_en: But the path of the righteous is like the light of dawn, which shines brighter and brighter until full day.
text_cn: 但是，义人的途径，像黎明的曙光，越来越明亮，直至成日中；

text_en: The way of the wicked is like deep darkness; they do not know what they stumble over.
text_cn: 恶人的道路，却宛如幽暗，他们不知道，要跌在何处。

text_en: My child, be attentive to my words; incline your ear to my sayings.
text_cn: 我儿，你要注意我的训言，侧耳倾听我的教导；

text_en: Do not let them escape from your sight; keep them within your heart.
text_cn: 不要让她离开你的视线，却要牢记在心中。

text_en: For they are life to those who find them, and healing to all their flesh.
text_cn: 因为，凡找着她的，必获得生命；他整个身躯，必获得健康。

text_en: Keep your heart with all vigilance, for from it flow the springs of life.
text_cn: 在一切之上，你要谨守你的心，因为生命是由此而生。

text_en: Put away from you crooked speech, and put devious talk far from you.
text_cn: 你应摒绝口舌的欺诈，远避唇舌的乖谬。

text_en: Let your eyes look directly forward, and your gaze be straight before you.
text_cn: 你的眼睛应向前直视，你的视线应向前集中。

text_en: Keep straight the path of your feet, and all your ways will be sure.
text_cn: 你要修平你脚下的行径，要巩固你一切的路途。

text_en: Do not swerve to the right or to the left; turn your foot away from evil.
text_cn: 你断不可左倾右依，务使你的脚远离邪恶。
